Trimmed copies of the Inertia `data-page` JSON island from mymtgo.com, captured
2026-09-26 (index: /metagame/modern?days=30, 3 of 40 decks kept; deck:
/metagame/modern/prowess, 3 of 42 matchup rows + 2 card rows kept). Used by
tests/test_mymtgo_scraper.py, which runs offline. Refresh this file if the site changes shape.

`event_synthetic.html` is a hand-built 5-player event in the REAL events/Show shape
(field names and row layout copied from /events/modern/12854911). It covers a bye,
an unpublished player (dan), a published-but-unclassified deck (eve), a playoff round,
a null-score row, and mirrored rows from both seats.
